description:
**St. Joseph's Hospital Kitovu**, located in **Masaka**, is hiring **Medical Officers** to join our clinical team. There are **2 open positions**.

## About the hospital

St. Joseph's Hospital Kitovu is a well-established hospital serving the people of Masaka and the surrounding districts. We are committed to providing quality, compassionate and affordable healthcare to the communities we serve, and we are looking for dedicated doctors to strengthen our clinical team.

## About the role

Medical Officers will be at the heart of patient care at the hospital, working across the outpatient department, inpatient wards and emergency care. You will diagnose and treat patients, conduct ward rounds, perform clerking and patient management, and assist with emergency and referral cases. You will work alongside nurses, clinical officers and other health workers, and contribute to the safe, professional delivery of care to every patient who walks through our doors.

## Key responsibilities

- Diagnose and treat patients in OPD, inpatient and emergency departments
- Conduct ward rounds, clerking and patient management
- Manage and follow up admitted patients, including emergency and referral cases
- Supervise and support nurses, clinical officers and other health workers
- Maintain accurate and up-to-date medical records and compile reports
- Participate in health education and health promotion activities
- Uphold professional standards, infection prevention and patient safety

## Job specifications

- Must have MBChB
- Registered with Uganda Medical and Dental Practitioners Council
- Aged above 25 years

## More information

- Tel: 0481 432 217
- Email: kitovu@ucmb.co.ug

## Deadline

Deadline for receiving applications: **6th September 2026**.

Interested and suitably qualified candidates are encouraged to submit their applications before the deadline.

required_documents: Application letter, updated CV, copies of academic certificates and transcripts, and proof of registration with the Uganda Medical and Dental Practitioners Council.
